headline: Recommended Bacon Construction Co. for the $43,899,700 base bid on Dual Language PK-8 school; approved $3,318,571.79 bond payment.
summary: Updates covered the high school punch list and budget closeout, track and field work, and the Dual Language PK-8 school bids. Members recommended Bacon Construction Co. for the Dual Language PK-8 school construction contract. Members also approved a $3,318,571.79 payment on Bond Series 2025 Requisition #4 and approved the August 5, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved the August 5, 2026 meeting minutes, with five abstentions.
Noted the School Committee's appointment of Jordana Ruggeri as its representative on the committee.

Recommended awarding the Dual Language PK-8 school construction contract to Bacon Construction Co., Inc. for a base bid of $43,899,700, with alternates up to $2,489,579, to the Central Falls Purchasing Board; all in favor.
Approved payment of $3,318,571.79 on Bond Series 2025 Requisition #4; all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: A. Lynch made a motion to approve the minutes as presented, seconded by A. Deburgo ... All in favor
The School Committee has appointed Jordana Ruggeri to serve as its representative on the School Building Committee.

A Lynch made a motion to recommend the award of the City of Central Falls, RFP 2026- 006- Dual Language Pk-8 School to Bacon Construction Co., Inc., the lowest qualified bidder for a base bid value of $43,899,700 and alternates up to but not exceeding $2,489,579 to the Central Falls Purchasing Board. ... All In Favor
S,. Friedman made a motion to approve the School Bond Series 2025 #4 for $ 3,318,571.79. B. Comet seconded the motion. No Discussion All In Favor
